- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided reasons for "All the Light We Cannot See" being a Pulitzer Prize winner, including:
  1. Unique narrative structure
  2. Lyrical prose
  3. Innovative use of radio and science
  4. Well-developed, complex characters
  5. Moral complexity and nuance
  6. Historical accuracy and research
